title: Holding the door
situation: Bola holds the door open from inside. Shim comes through and, once in, starts to pull it shut while Dot is still on her way; the door is pulled two ways for a moment, Bola wins, he lets go, Dot passes.
success_observation: Cardboard cut-out skin applied to 3D Bolas motion bank joints.
ledger: cardboard cut-out pieces (cast/dummy/ bola, shim, dot)
